name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps focus on the data, matching Manus’ competitive edge. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode in bright environments, but the toggle keeps the option open.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode risks glare drowning out alerts in bright rooms. The real alternative: default to light mode with a high-contrast dark toggle for error visibility. Settle it with user testing—measure error detection rates in both modes.
